Why the Quran is from God

Look, then look again

The Quran points to what anyone can see, and asks you to look closely and think.

Look at the camel, the sky, the mountains, the earth, the Quran says. Look for a flaw, then look again. It notices rain, clouds, springs, the stages of growth in the womb, and pairs in creation, and it uses them as signs: dead earth revives, so life can return. It is no science textbook, and this app does not say it predicted modern discoveries. It asks for your attention.

﴿أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ١٧ وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ١٨ وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ١٩ وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ٢٠﴾

Translation of the meaning

Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created? And at the sky - how it is raised? And at the mountains - how they are erected? And at the earth - how it is spread out?

Quran · Al-Ghashiyah 88:17-20

﴿ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ٣ ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

[And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks? Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

Quran · Al-Mulk 67:3-4

﴿إِنَّ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ١٩٠ ٱلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ قِيَـٰمًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَـٰذَا بَـٰطِلًا سُبْحَـٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ١٩١﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding - Who remember Allāh while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

Quran · Aal Imran 3:190-191

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَـٰشِعَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

Quran · Fussilat 41:39

There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard. Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

You might ask

QuestionDid the Quran foretell modern science?
AnswerThis app does not claim so. Most such claims read a modern idea into a general word. The old case for its wonder rested on language. The science claims are recent.Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:189
QuestionWhat can honestly be said, then?
AnswerThat it describes rain, clouds and springs correctly, and uses them to argue that life returns. Some phrases can be read in newer ways. That stays reflection, not proof.Quran · Fussilat 41:39
QuestionAren't there verses a scientist would question?
AnswerCritics name some, such as the sun setting in a muddy spring. That verse says how he found it. Press no verse beyond its words, in either direction.Quran · Al-Kahf 18:86

The signs are out in the world. The Quran asks you to go and look.
